append.detail:
2026-10-26: Daniel ruled the mobile app security advisory is low priority while the app is parked (open-questions answer 4A). Priority P1 to P3.

2026-10-26 fresh-main cfe4d52e6: remains OPEN/P3; no unsupported major overrides or audit exceptions. Official https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 lists Zod <4.6.6, patched4.6.6; Expo CLI58.1.13 declares ^3.25.76. Its two direct Zod consumers are DevToolsPlugin.schema.js and createMCPDevToolsExtensionSchema.js: plugin metadata/output and generated MCP command schemas. Output append caps at V8 MAX_STRING_LENGTH, not an independently established safe validation budget. MCP tunnel requires EXPO_UNSTABLE_MCP_SERVER and optional expo-mcp (absent from lock), but CLI/plugin parsing remains. App contract resolution already uses direct Zod4.6.7 through mobile/metro.config.js. Official https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv lists node-forge<=1.4.0 with no patched version; https://github.com/digitalbazaar/forge/issues/1149 unresolved. Actual Expo CLI->code-signing-certificates0.0.7 verifies self-signed certificates, generated manifest signatures and CSRs: generation-only non-reachability would be false. Current config has no updates.codeSigningCertificate; optional CLI/dev-signing paths remain. New mobile/scripts/expo-dependency-consumers.test.cjs exercises actual installed schema, PEM/certificate, signature and CSR consumers using synthetic local inputs plus Node crypto signature controls; wired into existing mobile test/CI command. Four compatibility cases pass, not advisory exploit regression or remediation. No real credentials/providers/native prebuild/APK/device operations. UUID11.1.1 remains separately repaired by SEC005. Supported upstream resolutions or independently reviewed backports with full consumer evidence, plus native/device and controlled provider acceptance, remain required for closure.

2026-10-27 fresh-main1c15d1823: official node-forge1.4.2 published today supersedes the previous no-supported-fix premise. Upstream commit https://github.com/digitalbazaar/forge/commit/2bce9d477a2ff436e86ff9694ae999f1552aa2bb requires canonical DER DigestInfo and explicitly addresses CVE-2026-85393; release https://github.com/digitalbazaar/forge/releases/tag/v1.4.2 also restores Buffer PEM compatibility after1.4.1. Lock-only supported patch updates both existing Expo consumers without dependency-range override, unrelated Metro refresh, or test/probe changes. Exact upstream tests/pocs/ghsa-2g46-22mc-6gwp.js run outside repository against installed dependencies:1.4.0 forged verify=true;1.4.2 throws invalid RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 DigestInfo. This is a focused advisory regression, not native/provider acceptance. Current Expo CLI still requires Zod^3.25.76; latest official3.x is3.25.76, so forcing4.x remains unjustified. SEC004 stays OPEN/P3 under the owner parked-mobile ruling. Bounded installed-version Zod comparison using64 valid strings with array.max(2) and counting element refinements: CLI3.25.76 rejects after64 element refinements; app4.6.7 rejects before any element refinement. This verifies the affected early-bound API behavior without memory-exhaustion testing. Official fix https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/pull/6652 targets v4 internals; actual Expo output schema lacks a finite max, so a library size-gate backport alone would not establish a consumer input budget.
